map.Ruth 恒压过滤方程：t/V = (μ α c)/(2 A² ΔP)·V +: Ruth constant-pressure filtration equation: t/V = (μ α c)/(2 A² ΔP)·V + (μ Rm)/(A ΔP), where V is the filtrate volume, α the specific cake resistance, c the concentration and Rm the medium resistance. Solving gives V = [−b + √(b² + 4 a t)] / (2a). The instantaneous flow is dV/dt = A ΔP / [μ (α c V/A + Rm)].
